cemc-cimc-2020-a3.prompt: A dish contains $100$ candies. Juan removes candies from the dish each day and no candies are added to the dish. On day 1, Juan removes $1$ candy. cemc-cimc-2020-a5.prompt: Determine all pairs $(x,y)$ of integers with $x\le y$ for which $\dfrac1x+\dfrac1y=\dfrac14$.

cemc-cimc-2020-a6.prompt: There are $90$ players in a league. Each of the $90$ players plays exactly one match against each of the other $89$ players. After all matches have been played, the points earned by each player are added up. What is the greatest possible number of players whose total score can be at least $54$ points?
